title: Pool Pump Runtime and Energy Cost
dataSources: Whole-home water flow (`watermeter:flow`), sump pump (`sumppump:event`), well pump (`wellpump:event`), pool/spa chemistry (`pool:chemistry`), water softener (`watersoftener:status`), irrigation zones (`irrigation:zone`).
app: Smart water meters (Flume / Flo / HomeWizard), sump- and well-pump sensors, pool/spa controllers, water-softener and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pool:chemistry event=pump
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(pump_watt_hours) as wh by _time
| eval kwh=round(wh/1000,2), cost=round(kwh*rate_per_kwh,2)
| sort - _time
description: Adds up how long the pool pump runs and what that costs, since the pump is often the single biggest energy user at home.
value: Pool pumps quietly dominate summer electricity bills; seeing their daily cost reveals how much shorter run-times could save.
implementation: Ingest pump energy readings; schedule daily and trend runtime cost.
visualization: Column chart of daily pool-pump energy cost.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up how much running the pool pump costs, which is often one of the biggest parts of the electricity bill.
